signature.name: VTask.map
signature.type: {α : Sort u_1} -> {β : Sort u_2} -> {p : α → Prop} -> {q : β → Prop} -> (f : α → β) -> (h : ∀ (a : α), p a → q (f a)) -> Subtype p → Subtype q
